newsitem.title: MEXICO: Banacci raises target price on Telmex.
newsitem.headline: Banacci raises target price on Telmex.

text.p: Grupo Financiero Banamex Accival SA de CV (Banacci) said Monday it has revised its year-end target price for Telefonos de Mexico (Telmex) to 21.50 pesos, up 7.5 percent from its previous target price.
"We have revised upward our target price for Telmex due to the favorable changes in the long-term perspectives of the company," Banacci said in its weekly analysis.
Banacci said that it would recommend buying Telmex if prices dip below 18.50 pesos in Mexico or 46-1/2 for its ADRs in New York.
Telmex closed unchanged in Mexico on Monday at 18.90 pesos. In New York, Telmex ADRs gained 1/8 to close at 47-3/8.
"At the current prices, we maitain our neutral recommendation," Banacci said.
